headline: Sunrun (RUN) Stock Fair Value Falls As Analysts Weigh Growth Projects And Cash Risks
summary: Sunrun’s latest internal fair value estimate has shifted from US$18.84 to US$17.05, signaling a more conservative stance on the stock’s pricing. This reset lines up with recent Street research that balances enthusiasm for Sunrun’s grid scale storage and AI related projects with concerns about execution, cash generation, and sector level risks.
